native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] Fileless Malware
native_rule.s1ql:
"(
  endpoint.os.process.name = 'Windows'
  AND event.category = 'Process'
)
AND
(
  (
    src.process.commandLine ILIKE 'RegRead'
    AND
    (
      src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'HKCU'
      OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'HKLM'
    )
    AND src.process.commandLine ILIKE 'eval'
    AND src.process.commandLine Does Not ContainCIS 'flag'
  )
  OR
  (
    src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'IEX'
    AND
    (
      src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE'
      OR src.process.commandLine contains:anycase 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE'
    )
    AND src.process.commandLine contains:anycase '::FromBase64String'
    AND src.process.commandLine contains:anycase '::ASCII.GetString'
  )
)"
